title: ID0447562-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / S5 170003652] Firmware Update Request
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  We are not able to update firmware. There is a notification Rollout
already initiated. We tried it last week and this issue is there since.
Please may I ask you for help? In total there are 3 chargers on this
location with this same error: 170003652, 170003653, 170003654
Solution: upload the hawkbit.conf
